PBRify models shipped in the APK as the assets pbrify-normal-int8.onnx, pbrify-height-int8.onnx,
pbrify-roughness-int8.onnx and pbrify-upscale-int8.onnx, int8 versions of PBRify's normal, height and roughness
networks and of its 4x upscaler, for the relief and gloss maps and the neural x2 textures the game makes on the device
from the player's own game files (src/libs/relief). No game texture, map or upscaled texture is shipped.

Author:    Kim2091, PBRify_Remix (https://github.com/Kim2091/PBRify_Remix): the SPAN models 1x-PBRify_NormalV3,
           1x-PBRify_Height and 1x-PBRify_RoughnessV2, released under CC0-1.0 (PBRify-CC0-1.0.txt).
Training:  OpenModelDB (openmodeldb.info/models/1x-PBRify-RoughnessV2, read 2026-11-14) lists the training dataset
           as "ambientCG + UltraSharpV2" (ambientCG's materials are CC0; UltraSharpV2 is Kim2091's upscaling model and
           its data). No separate licence is stated for the training data; the models themselves are CC0-1.0.
Export:    ONNX re-exports of those models by fernandotonon, QtMeshEditor-models
           (https://huggingface.co/fernandotonon/QtMeshEditor-models), revision
           b35b7f4c924936803bf79e868302d7f8f643d302, listed there as CC0-1.0. I/O 1x3xHxW float 0..1, free size.
Files:     1x-PBRify_NormalV3.onnx, 1640690 bytes,
           sha256 19d78f555f994219e2692876ab0fb6c3e4382503952dbe72d74db89d24870ba4
           1x-PBRify_Height.onnx, 1640690 bytes,
           sha256 2b14afd583148cb5b0a554bf86a009b6a898aadc00d213aa3ec2544e17c835f5
           1x-PBRify_RoughnessV2.onnx, 1640690 bytes,
           sha256 8a8de1bbeab70df8b2550bdc11fddd5a315a12eeb47d561ce55b38551ea52131
           (checked by make_models.py when it downloads them)
Modified:  by src/libs/relief/model/make_models.py: weights and activations quantised to int8 (static QDQ, per-channel
           weights, calibrated on procedural textures generated by the script; no game data), unused nodes dropped.
           Results (checked at build time):
           pbrify-normal-int8.onnx, 501397 bytes,
           sha256 fc91ce30e48deaf5847ed19342bd1fc7a8ffc11a2ec94f26c4d6bcbe63df4b33
           pbrify-height-int8.onnx, 501394 bytes,
           sha256 01f251dc40e79fa7ef5348b51f538de5a14bc6113c8ea3173ba78ce0b648c409
           pbrify-roughness-int8.onnx, 501397 bytes,
           sha256 860845c92142b7d1bd89ac514ae58206d431fd2c899e955dd492348389c5f00b
           The modified files stay CC0-1.0.
Use:       run with onnxruntime (MIT, onnxruntime-MIT.txt) on the player's device, in the game process.

Upscaler (pbrify-upscale-int8.onnx):
Author:    Kim2091, PBRify_Remix release v1.7.2
           (https://github.com/Kim2091/PBRify_Remix/releases/download/v1.7.2/PBRify_Remix-1.7.2.zip, 116606222 bytes,
           sha256 d787a88f644c542620f869e0c61e71f795488020fcece9a97e774ca2c2cecb0b), its file
           Extras/Old_Models/4x-PBRify_UpscalerSPANV4.pth (9016813 bytes,
           sha256 d1f1fa1af7a5ab23fcf143e75aac4951e6c52d56bf77d9ccd4d004a4831d0461), a 4x SPAN network, released under
           CC0-1.0 (the release's LICENSE; PBRify-CC0-1.0.txt).
Training:  the release's EXTRA_INFO.md: textures from ambientCG and PolyHaven (both CC0), degraded and DXT1-compressed,
           trained with traiNNer-redux. OpenModelDB (openmodeldb.info/models/4x-PBRify-UpscalerSPANV4, read 2026-11-14)
           lists the dataset as "ambientCG + UltraSharpV2" and the licence as CC0-1.0 (UltraSharpV2 is Kim2091's own
           upscaling model and its data; no separate licence is stated for it). The model itself is CC0-1.0.
Modified:  by src/libs/relief/model/make_upscale_model.py: exported to ONNX (opset 17, I/O 1x3xHxW float 0..1 and
           1x3x4Hx4W) with spandrel, weights and activations quantised to int8 (static QDQ, per-channel weights,
           calibrated on the procedural textures of make_models.py with 16 px wrap or mirror padding; no game data),
           unused nodes dropped. Result (checked at build time):
           pbrify-upscale-int8.onnx, 521540 bytes,
           sha256 5148c5c90562bdff8567dd612b427ebe001371d4abb906fb1358d94e1480f552
           The modified file stays CC0-1.0.
Use:       the game upscales a texture 4x with it on the player's device and box-filters the result to 2x in linear
           light (fx/upscale.hpp); the 2x textures are a cache in the app's cache directory.
